kind: independent public algorithmic experiment architecture; no measured results
design_basis: Final experiment design supplied by parent research agent

policy_switches.P: durably retained chosen plan including target bindings
policy_switches.R: terminal completion receipt and later-attempt fast path

retention: P1 plans remain after success for both R0 and R1; no completion-triggered plan garbage collection is depicted.
shared_frontend: Same synthetic conversation and generation frontend in all eight variants.
storage: Separate SQLite coordinator and effect-store files. Commit audit is read only by external evaluator.
fault_model: Fresh actual Python subprocess every attempt; abrupt os._exit at four declared phases; committed-effect exceptions; real coordinator generation reset through parent/child handshake.

boundary_legend.dashed: controlled conversation/failure histories or decision tape
boundary_legend.solid: executed algorithm, storage or process control

scope: Diagram of declared experiment architecture; no measured chart, success rate, historical code, source identity or previous experiment evidence is consumed.
visual_review: Complete: text shortened to fit boxes; arrows routed through whitespace; no label overlap or clipping observed.
figure_lint:
figure_lint: 1 caption(s), 0 error(s), 0 warning(s)
OK: figures and captions are consistent
implementation_validation: Verified against frozen independent study.py: generation check precedes receipt fast path; receipt and retained-plan hits bypass common source query; plans retained for both R settings; separate databases and unread audit.
barrier_precision: First put, not first effect: retire may commit its leading delete before the first put barrier.
